messages.content: Checkout latency is 2.3s and DB pool utilization is 100%. Logs show timeout acquiring database connection.
Root cause: database connection pool exhaustion. Evidence: pool utilization 100% and connection acquisition timeouts.
Checkout p95 is 2300ms and payment p95 is 2140ms after a payment retry change.
Root cause: Payment Service latency caused by increased provider retry/wait behavior.
Kafka lag rises from 850 to 18100 while worker processing time increases.
Root cause: slower order-worker processing causing Kafka consumer lag.
Pod memory grows from 610MB to 970MB and is OOMKilled; new unbounded request cache was deployed.
Root cause: memory leak caused by an unbounded in-memory request cache.
Database connection refused on port 5433 immediately after configuration deployment.
Root cause: invalid database port configuration.
Redis hit rate falls from 93% to 38% after TTL is changed from 30 minutes to 2 minutes.
Root cause: cache TTL reduction caused excessive misses and database load.
